title: Guided Breathing
content: Take slow and deep breaths. Inhale gently, hold for a few seconds, and slowly exhale. Repeat for several minutes.

title: Calming Meditation
content: Practice a short mindfulness meditation. Focus on your breathing and allow anxious thoughts to pass without judgment.

title: Relaxing Music
content: Listen to calm and relaxing music in a comfortable environment. Give yourself some quiet time to relax.

title: Fresh Air Walk
content: Take a short walk outside and focus on your surroundings. Gentle physical activity can help you release tension.

title: Positive Activity
content: Continue doing activities that make you feel happy and energetic. Spend time on hobbies that you enjoy.

title: Journaling
content: Write down your thoughts and feelings in a journal. Expressing your emotions can help you understand them better.

title: Stress Relief Exercise
content: Try a simple relaxation exercise. Relax your shoulders, breathe slowly, and focus your attention on the present moment.

title: Gratitude Practice
content: Write down three things you are grateful for today. Focus on positive experiences and meaningful moments.
